_about: Checks that are red on purpose: each one proves a bug that a PLAN-2.1 item fixes. The suite prints them as 'red (expected …)' and stays green; once the fix lands the check turns green, the suite then fails with FLIP until its line here is removed (the lead flips it on purpose). Key = the check id printed by the suite.

S.invalid_json.once.what: an answer that is not JSON is asked again by itself (up to 3 calls, the last a tier up) for one message

S.invalid_json.click.what: one click on Try again makes up to 3 calls

S.empty_completion.once.what: an empty answer is asked again by itself (the docs: never resend unchanged, never retry from a loop)

S.empty_completion.click.what: one click on Try again makes up to 3 calls

M.upstream_error.unclear.what: an unclear runner start is shown as 'Could not start', which invites a second run

D.deny.remembered.what: the morning check asks the denied browser permission again on the next day

B.two_writers.kept.what: after a save conflict the queued save of this page overwrites the other page's change

K.c20-retry.once.what: Try again in the chat adds your message a second time
